entries.german:
Abt Wilhelm von St. Gallen beurkundet den Verzicht Hartmanns und Ludwigs von Prassberg auf ihre Rechte an Vogtei und Kirchensatz Sitterdorf.

Wir von gottis ginadin abte Wilh. von sante Gallin 1 kundin allen den, die dizin brieue lesint || oder ho errint lesin, aen warhait alles des, so hie nah gischribin stat. Ir sont alle wissin für || war, de für vns kom her Hartman von Brahsberg 2 vnde a) sin bruoder Ludewig vnsers gotzhu||ses dienstman, vnde encigin sich offinlich vnde vrilich in vnser hant vnde hern Friderichs vnde hern Swiggers der Tumbin von Nuwenburg 3 hant aller der ansprach vnde alles des rehtis, so su hettin alt han wandin an der vogtae ze Sitrundorf 4, die die seibin her Friderich vnde her Swigger die Tumbin gabin reht vnde redilich ze kofin mit allim, so darzů ho ert, vnde mit reh b) hern c>... von Ende 5, vnde och an dem kilchinsace ze Sitrindorf, den sü dem seibin dem von Ende gabin vrilich vnde luterlich dur got mit allim reht. An dizin dingin wart gipflegin mit wort, mit werch, mit gibaerdin aller der gicierde, mit vf genn vnde enpfahinn aller der gicierde, so man bidarf ze so getanin dingin. De aber dis war si vnde staet bilib, do hangtin wir vnser ingisigil an dizin brieue. Wir her Hartman vnde Ludewig von Brahsberg viriehin aein warhet alles des, so dauor gischribin stat, vnde ze aenim offinim vrkunde hangtin wir baede vnsru ingisigil an dizin brieue. Diz bischah vnde wart dirre brieue gigebin ze sante Gallin, do man zalt von gottis giburte drucehinhundert jar, der VII idus maien, indic. der XIII. Do ze gegin warin her Hiltebolt der custer 6 vnde her Joh. von Gutingin 7 closterherrin ze sante Gallin, her Hug der lutpriester von sante Laur. 8, her H. von Honburg 9, her Egl. von Rosinberg 10 ritter, Braenci von Gutingin, H. von A emzz 11, Egl. vnde V olr. die vo egt von Wartinse 12, C. der Kamerer vnde anderr biderber lut ginuog.

entries.english:
Abbot Wilhelm of St. Gallen certifies Hartmann and Ludwig von Prassberg's renunciation of their rights to the bailiwick and right of patronage at Sitterdorf.

We, Abbot Wilhelm of St. Gallen by God's grace, make known to all who read or hear read this document the truth of everything written below. You should all know for certain that Hartmann von Prassberg and his brother Ludwig, ministerials of our monastery, came before us and openly and freely renounced into our hands and the hands of Lords Friedrich and Swigger the Tumb von Neuburg every claim and right they had or might have had concerning the bailiwick at Sitterdorf, which the same Lords Friedrich and Swigger the Tumb had lawfully and properly purchased, with everything belonging to it, and with the rights of Lord ... von Ende, and also concerning the right of patronage at Sitterdorf, which they freely and clearly gave to the same man von Ende for God's sake, with every right. In this matter every requirement necessary for such an act was fulfilled in word, deed, gesture, undertaking, and acceptance. So that this be true and remain firm, we have attached our seal to this document. We, Lords Hartmann and Ludwig von Prassberg, affirm as true everything written above and, as open testimony, have both attached our seals to this document. This took place and this document was issued at St. Gallen in the year 1300 from the birth of Christ, on the seventh day before the Ides of May, in the thirteenth indiction. Present were Lord Hiltebold the sacristan, Lord John von Güttingen, a conventual of St. Gallen; Lord Hugh, parish priest of St. Lawrence; Lord H. of Honburg; Lord Eglolf von Rosenberg, Ritter; Braenci von Güttingen; H. of A emzz; Eglolf and Volrich, bailiffs von Wartensee; C., the chamberlain; and many other worthy people.

Seals: three seals; the first is missing; the second is 3.5 cm in diameter, inscribed +S.LVDE WICI.DE.BRAHSPER; the third is 4.5 cm in diameter, inscribed +S.HARTMANNI.DE.BRAHSPC.
